outcome: trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) success rate
cohort: 159 parturient women attempting labor after one prior low transverse cesarean section at Hangzhou Women's Hospital between February 2015 and March 2020.
finding: A nomogram predictive model for VBAC after a single cesarean section, incorporating gestational age at delivery, Bishop score, and newborn birth weight, was developed and demonstrated good predictive efficacy with an AUC of 0.83.
mod_finding: Shorter gestational age at delivery, lower newborn birth weight, and a higher cervical Bishop score were identified as independent factors favorable for successful VBAC.
birth_weight: Newborn birth weight was identified as a significant factor affecting VBAC success, with lower weight being favorable.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was identified as a significant factor affecting VBAC success, with shorter age being favorable.
